outcome: Pro-inflammatory tumor necrosis factor-alpha messenger RNA (mRNA) levels
Number of CD45-positive cells in the lung
cohort: Twenty preterm lambs surgically delivered after 132 days of gestation were randomized to different ventilation strategies or served as unventilated controls.
finding: Ventilation with OLEV was feasible and resulted in a significantly higher mean ventilation pressure; a small reduction in pulmonary inflammation after 24 h of support with OLEV suggests potential to reduce preterm lung injury compared to standard MV.
